content.name: Potion of Growth
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain the "enlarge" effect of the {@spell enlarge/reduce} spell for {@dice 1d4} hours (no {@status concentration} required). The red in the potion's liquid continuously expands from a tiny bead to color the clear liquid around it and then contracts. Shaking the bottle fails to interrupt this process.

content.name: Potion of Growth
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain the "enlarge" effect of the {@spell Enlarge/Reduce|SRD52} spell for 10 minutes (no {@status Concentration|SRD52} required).
The red in the potion's liquid continuously expands from a tiny bead to color the clear liquid around it and then contracts. Shaking the bottle fails to interrupt this process.
